recognize_zh: 箭頭處是一團黏聚的大型細胞，共享大片深藍色細胞質、界線不清，核大而圓、染色質細緻並有多個明顯核仁，細胞比周邊的造血細胞大得多，左下另有一顆含細胞質空泡的細胞；這種黏聚成團、核仁明顯的非造血細胞，是骨髓轉移性腺癌。
features: Cohesive cluster of large non-hematopoietic cells with indistinct borders (arrow)
Large round to oval nuclei with finely granular chromatin and multiple conspicuous nucleoli
Moderate to abundant basophilic, somewhat foamy cytoplasm
Single detached cell at lower left with a large cytoplasmic vacuole indenting the nucleus (possible mucin/signet-ring-like vacuole)
Background red cells, scattered platelets and stain precipitate; eyepiece photograph with blue-green cast
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cohesive cluster of large cells with indistinct cell borders, abundant basophilic cytoplasm and large round nuclei with fine chromatin and multiple prominent nucleoli. A nearby single cell contains a large cytoplasmic vacuole that indents the nucleus. These cells are morphologically distinct from hematopoietic elements. Findings are consistent with metastatic adenocarcinoma involving the bone marrow; trephine biopsy with immunohistochemistry is needed to confirm epithelial origin and suggest a primary site.

ddx.vs: Osteoblasts have small nucleoli, uniform eccentric nuclei and a Golgi zone away from the nucleus, without prominent multiple nucleoli or vacuoles.
Cells are discohesive with eccentric nuclei and perinuclear hof and are CD138/MUM1 positive and keratin negative.
May show prominent nucleoli but often contains fine melanin pigment and is S100/SOX10/HMB45 positive rather than keratin positive.

ddx.dx: Acute megakaryoblastic leukemia or erythroid clusters
ddx.vs: Blast clusters have scant cytoplasm with blebs or deep blue rims and express CD61 or E-cadherin/CD71 rather than cytokeratin.
